facts.label: Passivo presente no hotel
facts.sub: Afirmativo: Breakfast is included. Negativo: The minibar is not included. Pergunta: Is it served? Agente: by housekeeping.

facts.label: Está incluído
facts.sub: Use is/are + participle para dizer o que faz parte do preço: Breakfast is included. Tea and coffee are included. O sujeito recebe a ação, por isso o verbo fica no passivo.

facts.label: É servido
facts.sub: Use is served para comida e bebida: Breakfast is served from seven to ten. Plural: Drinks are served at the bar. Lembre que served é o particípio de serve.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The present passive uses am, is or are + participle.
We say “Breakfast includes in the price”.
By + agent tells who does the action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The present passive uses am, is or are + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Breakfast includes in the price”. → Falso (We say Breakfast is included.)
By + agent tells who does the action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Rules and services at a hotel · 1/3
paragraphs: Edinburgh is a grey and beautiful city on a hill. Ben arrives at a small hotel with a heavy bag. His friend Gwen works there on Saturdays. She shows him the room and explains the rules. In hotels, many things are done for the guests. Ben wants to know what is included.
“Welcome to Edinburgh, Ben! Breakfast is included in the price.” says Gwen. “Great. When is it served? I wake up early.” says Ben. “It is served from seven to ten in the dining room.” says Gwen.
